name: Travelers
description: Hundreds of years from now, the last surviving humans discover the means of sending consciousness back through time, directly into people in the 21st century. These "travelers" assume the lives of seemingly random people, while secretly working as teams to perform missions in order to save humanity from a terrible future.

videos.title: Travelers
videos.overview: Five strangers become an elite team of secret operatives when time travelers take over their conscious minds, to try to correct the terrible problems that face humanity in their own time.

videos.title: Protocol 6
videos.overview: The team's first mission goes awry when a fatal mistake leaves them holding a ticking time bomb.

videos.title: Aleksander
videos.overview: A team member buckles under the guilt of not being allowed to prevent future deaths and puts the travelers in jeopardy.

videos.title: Hall
videos.overview: MacLaren’s leadership is challenged when he’s directed to assist a more experienced team of travelers that wants to join forces.

videos.title: Room 101
videos.overview: MacLaren is on his own as he fights to unravel the mystery of his team’s sudden disappearance.

videos.title: Helios-685
videos.overview: The team tackles their primary mission: stop a cataclysmic event that could change the course of human history.

videos.title: Protocol 5
videos.overview: The team struggles to live 21st century lives as they’re faced with the prospect that their missions might be over for good.

videos.title: Donner
videos.overview: MacLaren has to find a lone bomber who kills a newly arrived group of travelers.

videos.title: Bishop
videos.overview: MacLaren is kept on a tight leash after the Director orders an assassination.

videos.title: Kathryn
videos.overview: Teetering on the brink of death, MacLaren slips in and out of his host's memories.

videos.title: Marcy
videos.overview: Trevor defies the Director while the team contends with Marcy’s inevitable death.

videos.title: Grace
videos.overview: The team is torn apart when they discover the Director has a hidden agenda.

videos.title: Ave Machina
videos.overview: Grant MacLaren and his team find themselves in FBI custody with no means of escape, while a mysterious new traveler reveals secrets to his psychiatrist.

videos.title: Protocol 4
videos.overview: Philip makes an unexpected connection, Marcy helps David cope with his trauma, and MacLaren discovers a shocking truth that Kathryn has been hiding from him.

videos.title: Jacob
videos.overview: After tracking down a missing traveler, the team is led to some disturbing answers about their kidnapping.
MacLaren and the team must help a fellow traveler plan his own assassination, while helping an unsuspecting activist complete a deadly mission.

videos.title: Jenny
videos.overview: A deadly disease is spreading around the world, and the travelers must get to the bottom of where it came from and how to stop it before it's too late.

videos.title: U235
videos.overview: With the unknown virus rapidly spreading, the team is left with only one option in order to save The Director hundreds of years in the future.

videos.title: 17 Minutes
videos.overview: A skydiving traveler must try, repeatedly, to save our team from a horrible fate.

videos.title: Traveler 0027
videos.overview: After receiving an unusual message to attend a court proceeding, the travelers find that one of their own is on trial for conspiring against The Director and interrupting the Grand Plan.

videos.title: Update
videos.overview: Philip’s timeline receives an update with some unwanted side effects, Trevor makes a disturbing discovery about his host’s past, and MacLaren deals with the return of a traveler he thought had gone away for good.

videos.title: 21C
videos.overview: While MacLaren, Carly, Trevor, and Philip work with another traveler team to protect a child important to the future, Marcy takes measures to remember her past life – but uncovers more than she bargained for.

videos.title: Simon
videos.overview: When the team meets Simon, a homeless man with a startling history, they’re led down a path that leads directly to the very first traveler.
In the season finale, the travelers must follow the rules of a madman in order to rescue their kidnapped loved ones and ensure the traveler program isn’t exposed to the world.

videos.title: Ilsa
videos.overview: MacLaren, his team and their loved ones regroup at a safe house protected by the FBI, but doubts and betrayals may sabotage the rest of their mission.

videos.title: Yates
videos.overview: MacLaren and Yates adjust to their new partnership while protecting a TV show host whose inflammatory rhetoric about Travelers has led to tragedy.

videos.title: Protocol 3
videos.overview: Certain that his team erased his memory of the previous day, MacLaren retraces his steps in the case of a disturbed youth with a horrific future.

videos.title: Perrow
videos.overview: The team learns that Traveler 001 is still alive when the Faction tries to capture him. Doubts about their loved ones worsen for Kat, Jess and David.

videos.title: Naomi
videos.overview: The team attempts to extract a rogue A.I. from a child messenger, but the program expands too rapidly. A new Traveler adjusts to his host.

videos.title: Philip
videos.overview: The Faction kidnaps Philip and a group of other historians, forcing MacLaren and the team to extract their location from a critically injured Hall.

videos.title: Trevor
videos.overview: Suffering from a fatal brain disorder, Trevor makes the choice to allow himself to be overwritten as the team races to invent an experimental cure.

videos.title: Archive
videos.overview: MacLaren urges Yates to help him when a Traveler with a mission vital to humanity's survival arrives in the body of a just-captured serial killer.

videos.title: David
videos.overview: The Faction sets off nuclear blasts that destroy all of the Travelers' archives, except the one in which a wounded David just happens to be trapped.

videos.title: Protocol Omega
videos.overview: Shattered by recent losses and a sweeping new protocol, the Travelers face a bleak future with only one long-shot chance to succeed in their mission.
